normalization_assessment.v2_dialects: main c86e29ec vs b21 27436c27 (and b11 af40c354) differ ONLY in doc comments; the executed V2_SQL strings are byte-identical (ddl_fingerprint_sha256 3dd3e899... for all three). Table structures cannot diverge. Contract C2's conditional ('if table structures diverge in a way later migrations assume, add a fresh normalization migration v10') is therefore NOT triggered: no v10 normalization migration was added. Migration files v1-v9 are shipped unmodified (append-only chain), and the chain from EITHER v2 dialect file to v9 is the same byte sequence of SQL.
normalization_assessment.unknown_shape_handling: Any catalog whose physical layout diverges from every shipped producer (e.g. v2 marker with group_members missing) fails closed: the v9 rebuild aborts inside its migration transaction, the open errors, no partial rebuild survives, and pre-existing rows are preserved. Covered by tests/store_migrate.rs::unknown_layout_fails_closed_with_data_preserved, newer_catalog_refused_with_data_preserved, and read_only_open_never_migrates (read-only queries never upgrade).
